service_model.backpressure: Do not issue another external-audio request while IFR63 is pending or the priority-5 service is active.
service_model.completion: Firmware cleared IFR63 and CPU IPL returned below 5.

interpretation: The earlier continuous-mode UI failure was caused by missing recurring DSPI1 eDMA service and interrupt coalescing, not a demonstrated ColdFire TCG throughput ceiling. The corrected model sustains native ISR completions and remains interactive at the provisional 10 ms cadence.
limit: The physical external-audio interrupt period has not been measured. This pass does not claim that the emulator sustains the hardware's presumed 32-frame / 48 kHz cadence or glitch-free host playback.

next_gate.name: AR172_QEMU_AUDIO_CLOCK_PROVENANCE_GATE
next_gate.objective: The 32-frame / 48 kHz candidate now passes with host PCM. Prove the exact source-63 clock register and phase relationship.
